SUPERIOR COURT OF NEW JERSEY
PASSAIC COUNTY SUPERIOR COURT
SHERIFF'S SALE NO. 26000708
DOCKET NO. F 012155 25 CTL # 163187
PLAINTIFF – NEWREZ LLC D/B/A SHELLPOINT MORTGAGE SERVICING
DEFENDANTS- DOMINICK VIEIRA, ET ALS
Writ of Execution.
By virtue of the above stated Writ of Execution to me directed and delivered I will expose for sale at public vendue on
Tuesday THE 18th DAY OF August 2026
between the hours of two and five o'clock in the afternoon of said day, that is to say at 2:00 P.M. prevailing time at Commissioner’s Meeting Room, Room 220 Administration Building, 401 Grand Street, Paterson, New Jersey to wit:
All that tract or parcel of land, situate, lying and being in the Borough of Ringwood, County of Passaic and State of New Jersey:
Being known as: Tax Lot 5 Block 733
Dimensions: 203.82FT x 21.33FT x 4.62FT x 198.40FT x 184.99FT x 224.31FT x 17.15FT x 40.00FT
Nearest Cross Street: Skyline Lakes Drive
Please be advised that defnitive occupancy information is not available and Plaintiff makes no respresentation regarding occupancy
Good Faith Estimated Upset: $ 281,268.58
*Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by Plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether any outstanding interest remains of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so, the current amount due thereon.
** If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the MOrtgagor, the Mortgagee or the Mortgagee's attorney.
*** After the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be depostied into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order firecting payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
****Pursuant to 28, U.S.C Section 2410, this sale is subject to a 120 day right of redemption held by the United States of America b virtue of its lien: Mortgage: Dominick Vieira and Devon Stolba to the SECRETARY OF HOUSING AND URBAN DEVELOPMENT dated May 31,2024 and recorded on July 29, 2024 in book M1899, page 149, to secure $47,355.89.
PREMISES COMMONLY KNOWN AS:
89 MT. GLEN Road Ringwood, NJ 07456
A more complete metes and bounds description can be found in the Office of the Passaic County Sheriff.
Lien(s)/Taxes:
Note: The street address is merely given as a convenience to the bidders and is not a representation of fact on the part of the sheriff. The diagram or concise description does not constitute a full legal description of the premises, but it can be found in the Passaic County Sheriff Office.
Subject to any unpaid taxes, municipal liens or other charges, and any such taxes, charges, liens, insurance premiums or other advances made by plaintiff prior to this sale. All interested parties are to conduct and rely upon their own independent investigation to ascertain whether or not any outstanding interest remain of record and/or have priority over the lien being foreclosed and, if so the current amount due thereon.
If the sale is set aside for any reason, the Purchaser at the sale shall be entitled only to a return of the deposit paid. The Purchaser shall have no further recourse against the Mortgagor, the Mortgagee and the Mortgagee’s attorney.
Surplus Money: If after the sale and satisfaction of the mortgage debt, including costs and expenses, there remains any surplus money, the money will be deposited into the Superior Court Trust Fund and any person claiming the surplus, or any part thereof, may file a motion pursuant to Court Rules 4:64-3 and 4:57-2 stating the nature and extent of that person's claim and asking for an order directing payment of the surplus money. The Sheriff or other person conducting the sale will have information regarding the surplus, if any.
The approximate amount due on this execution is $271,783.82 plus interest, cost, printers’ fees, Sheriff's fees and commission. The prior liens, as per affidavit of consideration are not a representation of fact on the part of the Sheriff.
Thomas Adamo
SHERIFF
Advertised in the Passaic County Sheriff Website
DATED: July 28, 2026
Pincus & Tarab, Attorneys at law PLLC
525 North Route 73
Suite 309
Marlton, NJ 08053
